title: Puck release profile (puck.release.profile.v1)
description: A puck.release.profile.v1 document: what puck qualify holds a producer-built Puck.World package to. It records how the package was published and where a World run finds a shader compiler, the functional canaries run against the package, the stability matrix (every backend, resolution and workload), each workload's warm-up, soak and churn in ticks and frames, never in time, the memory threshold of every matrix cell, and the checks qualification defers with the reason each is deferred.

publish.description: How the package is published and how a World run in it finds a shader compiler.

mode.description: The publish mode the package's entry assembly must show.
mode.title: ReleasePublishMode

entryAssembly.description: The entry assembly's file name inside the package, which a leg launches with dotnet.

compiler.description: Where a World run in the package finds a shader compiler.
compiler.title: ReleaseCompilerDiscovery

publish.title: ReleasePublish

backends.description: The graphics backends every cell runs on, in the order they run.

debugLayers.description: The backends whose validation layer every leg on them enables, by booting its World with --debug-layers. A leg on a listed backend fails on any validation message; a leg on an unlisted backend runs with its layer off.

functional.description: The puck canary proofs run against the package's own World before the matrix: the functional half of qualification.

resolutions.description: The offscreen output extents every workload runs at.

width.description: The width in pixels; even, so a half-size resize is exact.

height.description: The height in pixels; even, so a half-size resize is exact.

workloads.description: What each cell boots and does.

items.description: What one workload boots and does in every cell it runs in. Lengths are ticks of the world's own simulation clock or frames the pipeline instance submits, never time.

name.description: The workload's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, since it names files and cells.

world.description: The world document the cell boots, relative to the package directory with forward slashes; a .world.json document, which a generated overlay beside it takes as its basis.

warmupTicks.description: The ticks run before the first reading.

soakTicks.description: The ticks of each soak window, across which no GPU object may be created.

worldReloads.description: How many times the cell reloads the world document from disk.

pipeline.description: The pipeline instance the cell churns, or null for none.

layout.description: The views.layouts row whose slot shows the instance.

settleFrames.description: The submissions counted after each reset before the instance is inspected, enough for a replaced graph and its held images to retire.

reloads.description: How many times the instance recompiles and installs its source (pipeline.reload).

resizes.description: How many times the instance's slot shrinks to half its extent on each axis and returns.

loads.description: How many times the instance is unloaded (its row removed) and loaded again as a new instance.

pipeline.title: QualificationPipeline

timeoutSeconds.description: The wall-clock ceiling a leg is killed at: a backstop for a hung World, never a measurement or a threshold.

items.title: QualificationWorkload

thresholds.description: One memory threshold row per matrix cell.

items.description: The memory threshold of one matrix cell.

peakOwnedPipelineBytes.description: The most bytes the workload's pipeline instance may own or plan to own at once, read from every pipeline.inspect's owned= and peak=; required for a workload with a pipeline, and null for one without.

peakDeviceLocalBytes.description: The most device-local bytes the World process may hold at once, read from every world.counters --json reading's gpu.memory.device-local.peak; null until the cell has a reading on the reference device to set it from.

items.title: QualificationThreshold

deferred.description: The checks qualification does not make yet, each with why.

items.description: A check qualification does not make yet.

reason.description: Why it is deferred and what it waits on.

items.title: QualificationDeferral
